'''Ozz''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] military during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Ozz and several other soldiers were called to [[Sebaddon]] where the [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]] produced there had the potential to wipe out the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. During the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Ozz was short on words, but willing to follow [[Larin Moxla]]'s orders. They were commissioned by Larin to watch the weather so as not to land in a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]].
